messages.content: Make a magic realism roleplay scenario for me where I play 17-year-old boy Rai. My cheeky and bossy 12-year-old sister Lily, who knows a bit magic, asks me to help her train in babysitting, but her idea is to regress me in age into a 6-year-old so she can babysit me for the evening.  Only I control what Rai says and do. Create stairs by incrementally indenting each new line.

The kitchen glows gold, and the clock ticks a half-beat too slowly.
  Lily stands by the counter with a spellbook fluttering under her arm.
    "I need a practice baby," she says, eyes bright and bossy.
      "You can turn six for the evening," she adds.
        "I'll take care of you. Please help me practice."
          A candle turns pale blue, and a chalk boy appears on the table, blinking once.
            She taps the drawing, folds her arms, and waits for your answer.
              The room holds its breath, the magic patient until you decide.
